mr_title: fix(material/tabs): nav bar not navigating on enter presses
mr_description: Fixes that the tab nav bar wasn't navigating when pressing the enter key.

expected_issues.title: Space key on a tab link no longer prevents page scrolling
expected_issues.description:
When activating an enabled tab link with the space key, the handler clicks the link but no longer calls preventDefault(), so the browser also scrolls the page.

The change adds Enter handling and restructures the branches; preventDefault() is now only called for disabled links. Space on a focused element scrolls the page by default, so keyboard users activating a tab link with Space get an unexpected scroll. preventDefault() must still be called for Space (but not for Enter, which would break link navigation).
